listing.name: Mobile Suit Gundam Extreme VS. Maxiboost ON — MaxiboostPort (johnnygentoo)
listing.original_game_title: Mobile Suit Gundam Extreme VS. Maxiboost ON
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project reports early offline Free Battle at 60 FPS, saves and split-screen play, plus limited online tests using two instances or two PCs and one DLC. Complete mode coverage and the full game have not been confirmed. Portcove has not tested networking. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own North American PS4 CUSA18758 base version 1.00 and update 1.15.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Merge or hardlink your own CUSA18758 base version 1.00 and update 1.15 files as the project describes. Run game_check.py, then follow the README’s build and launcher instructions. Optional DLC requires your own separately obtained copy.

warnings: The project reports early offline Free Battle at 60 FPS, saves and split-screen play, plus limited online tests using two instances or two PCs and one DLC. Complete mode coverage and the full game have not been confirmed. Portcove has not tested networking.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
